feature: Sky draw-state inspection and recorded-ray controls

scope.runtime: Existing a916f95 private desktop executable/PCK/game helper, with current eabc8d9 sky script substitution except global class registration. Source diagnostics only; no complete-current-source package acceptance.
scope.native_diagnostic: One temporary read-only LD_PRELOAD draw-state recorder compiled with gcc -shared -fPIC -O2 -Wall -Wextra -Werror sky_draw_trace.c -o libsky_draw_trace.so -ldl -pthread. Applied only to draw-mixed01; all observed Vulkan arguments forwarded unchanged.
scope.android: Read-only device inventory; no launch, write or installation. Normal app untouched.

draw_state.scope: Read-only Vulkan calls at each actual sky vkCmdDraw. Push constants, current bound graphics pipeline, dynamic viewport and scissor captured per command buffer; state resets at vkBeginCommandBuffer. All forwarded arguments unchanged.

findings.draw_state_interpretation: 17,172 actual sky draws have complete recorder state, three vertices and one instance. Each viewport/scissor and camera-constant set is fixed. Each view pass has the expected two pipeline handles for original/current source. Restoring the same original half/full pipeline, layout, viewport and scissor changes the cloud buffer. This rules out an observed Vulkan pipeline/viewport/scissor switch for that restored-reference transition, not all internal driver/raster state.
findings.reconstruction: Fragment-coordinate and explicit-FMA ray reconstruction retain candidate/reference differences; FMA also changes on restoration. Screen-UV reconstruction passes one 90-check run but changes original ray/cloud maps and is not a qualified fix.

fixed_ray_input.scope: RGBA32F camera-ray texture from the three separately captured original-state-A EYEDIR components. This is a constructed fixed input, not simultaneous vector capture. Bottom nine rows are below-horizon (0,-1,0), preserving empty cloud output there.

findings.fixed_ray_scope: 31.640625 MiB diagnostic RGBA32F texture, joined from three separate original-state-A component captures, with bottom nine below-horizon rows replaced by (0,-1,0). Not a runtime cache proposal. Upload bytes are exact; fixed Y readback matches the original component bits at all 2,056,320 analysed pixels.
findings.fixed_red_and_y: All eight fixed-rays-y01 captures match the exact original red state a0d73d7b21d60cd68773c9510031d8411fac4128f156e9a147058fbd88465ad1 and original Y map 5b864d565d25d04f2edbc38d0b4f7ad28c8f5d0d90220d1b4cd3e65fdb26761f.86 checks / 0 failures.
findings.fixed_rgba: Seven of eight complete original-colour cloud buffers exactly match the original state A. One held capture changes only two green half-float values, at (1659,153) and (853,291); red, blue and transmittance remain exact. The full scene also changes at 57 pixels, peak 1/255. Original/current, repeat and restoration pairs are exact in this run; the held control fails.93 checks / 2 failures.
findings.encoded_green: In an altered program, floatBitsToUint(clouds.g) is encoded before engine postprocessing. All eight complete maps are identical while real red scattering still exactly matches the original state A.86 checks / 0 failures. This does not prove the original RGBA program had the same pre-postprocessing arithmetic.

rounding_illustration.scope: CPU arithmetic illustration only, including a toward-zero half conversion model. At(853,291), separate versus fused addition followed by this model reproduces the two native values. It does not prove the GPU uses either instruction sequence or conversion mode, or establish the original program's pre-postprocessing green value.

sky_debanding_control.limit: The corrected control passes 95 checks with exact native RGBA and all scene comparisons. Changing a display feature and supplying recorded rays is an isolation experiment. It is not production appearance/quality acceptance or a fix. The separate full-sky residual is retained.

fixture_corrections: The viewport debanding flag does not remove the sky shader render_mode.

A first attempted sky-mode removal matched the wrong text and was a no-op; a release assert did not stop it. Corrected explicit checks and frozen-source inspection verify every ray replacement and the actual mode removal. Both ineffective ablations remain in raw results.
The ray analyser now refuses unfinished/missing captures and snapshots its own source. The green map is explicitly labelled as a cloud scalar despite legacy ray_sha256 field names.

all_run_totals.meaning: Investigation totals including rejected/no-op controls and real failed equality checks, not release acceptance.

limitations: No image tolerance relaxed; no new shader optimization promoted.
No timing claim: extra texture, byte encodings, readbacks and interception alter the workload.
draw-mixed01, fixed-rays-y01 and fixed-rays-rgba01 overlap another project's Godot process; other completed runs observe none. No other process is stopped or modified.
No driver, compiler, FMA, interpolation, storage-rounding or postprocessing defect is established as the sole cause.
Original report-device validation, Windows, full-current-source package acceptance and separate Adreno650 Mobile water flicker remain open.
next_actions: Use recorded-ray controls to distinguish cloud-march math from upstream view-ray variability when evaluating further optimizations. Keep ordinary-image controls and report their failures separately; do not use diagnostic texture/feature substitutions as production acceptance.
Finish isolating the tiny original-colour/whole-sky residual before claiming complete scene stability. Do not repeat pipeline/viewport or failed reconstruction probes without new evidence.
The fixed-cumulus candidate has recorded fair-weather benefit; phase hoisting and weather caching already have documented limited gains or quality/memory losses. Do not repeat them as untested.
Retain eabc8d9 seam repair, c34f19d reflection skip, High bounds, .8/.9 usability fixes and separate cloud controls. No playthroughs or unsolicited packages.
